adjudication: Every native whole crop and every final lettering snippet inspected. Model clear statuses and reviewer-draft pixel boxes were not accepted without native review.
Coastal overlap fragments completed once; distinct repeated personal names and watercourse inscriptions retained separately.
Corrected Tremaine’s Mine, Cape Breton Co’s Mine, lighthouse 54 ft, Rock 10 ft high, T. E. Fraser, and D. McInnes from original pixels.
Rotated native mining text reads LEVEL and Four feet seam, not Fourteen Seam or an island/road name. Native island captions read SMITH Iᵈ. and HENRY Iᵈ.; no Port Hood Island label invented.
Combined Post Road to Mabou, Road to Whycocomagh, Little Judique Brook, Kewstoke Brook, Southeast Mabou River, Southwest Mabou River, and Judique Intervale Brook from complete source lettering.
Retained red This region was not surveyed. as historical survey context; excluded report/page references and geological unit codes.
Qualified Robert McGeen surname and three waterfall numerals whose units remain unresolved. No modern names, ownership, elevation or geography inferred.
limitations: Finalized means the initial source inventory and crop audit are complete with qualified readings. It does not certify infallibility, geographic placement, georeferencing acceptance, feature survival or current property/site conditions.
